panel.title: Lab partner
panel.byline: Muse Spark · hints first, friends first
panel.intro: Ask about your wiring, your code or a fault. I give hints before answers, and if a friend in your room has done this lesson, I ask them first.

hint.label: Stuck?
hint.askHint: Give me a hint, not the answer.

suggest.error: What does this compile error mean?
suggest.safety: What should I be careful about?

tools.highlightOff: The 3D figure isn’t loaded yet, so this part isn’t highlighted.
tools.manual: This bench can’t apply it for you. Copy it and make the change yourself.
tools.diffLabel: Changes: lines starting with + are added, lines starting with − are removed.
tools.askPeerNoRoom: A friend who has done this could explain it. Invite someone to build with you.
tools.question: “{question}”

errors.not_configured: The lab partner isn’t set up on this deployment.
errors.rate_limited: Lots of questions right now. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
errors.bad_input: That couldn’t be sent. Try a shorter question.
errors.upstream: The partner didn’t answer this time. Try again.
errors.offline: You’re offline. The lab still works; the partner needs a connection.

status.unavailable: The lab partner isn’t set up on this deployment
status.unavailableBody: Everything else in the lab works without it. The partner needs a Meta Model API key on the server.
status.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the server to check the partner.

voice.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser to talk.
voice.unsupported: Voice input isn’t available in this browser.
voice.unavailable: Voice isn’t set up on this deployment.
voice.empty: I didn’t catch that. Try again, a little closer to the mic.
voice.failed: Your voice couldn’t be turned into text. Try again or type.

story.title: Build Story
story.intro: Turn this session into a short story with a cover: who built what, what broke and who helped.
story.empty: Nothing to tell yet. Wire something, run code or ask the partner, then come back.
story.unavailable: Build Stories aren’t set up on this deployment.
story.failed: The story couldn’t be written. Try again.
story.noCover: The cover couldn’t be drawn this time, so the story has none.
